import os

try:
    from bs4 import BeautifulSoup
except ImportError:
    print("🔧 Installing beautifulsoup4...")
    os.system("pip install beautifulsoup4")
    from bs4 import BeautifulSoup

import requests
import re
import urllib.parse
import urllib3

# Disable SSL warnings (not recommended for production)
urllib3.disable_warnings(urllib3.exceptions.InsecureRequestWarning)

class PfSenseAutomator:
    def __init__(self, base_url, username, password):
        self.base_url = base_url
        self.username = username
        self.password = password
        self.session = requests.Session()
        self.session.verify = False  # Disable SSL verification
        self.session.headers.update({
            'User-Agent': 'Mozilla/5.0 (X11; Linux x86_64; rv:109.0) Gecko/20100101 Firefox/115.0',
            'Accept': 'text/html,application/xhtml+xml,application/xml;q=0.9,image/avif,image/webp,*/*;q=0.8',
            'Accept-Language': 'en-US,en;q=0.5',
            'Accept-Encoding': 'gzip, deflate, br',
            'Referer': f'{base_url}/index.php',
            'Upgrade-Insecure-Requests': '1'
        })

    def login(self):
        # Step 1: Get the login page to extract CSRF token
        login_page = self.session.get(f'{self.base_url}/index.php')
        soup = BeautifulSoup(login_page.text, 'html.parser')

        csrf_input = soup.find('input', {'name': '__csrf_magic'})
        if not csrf_input:
            raise Exception("Could not find CSRF token on login page")
        csrf_token = csrf_input['value']

        # Step 2: Perform login
        login_data = {
            '__csrf_magic': csrf_token,
            'usernamefld': self.username,
            'passwordfld': self.password,
            'login': 'Sign In'
        }

        login_response = self.session.post(
            f'{self.base_url}/index.php',
            data=login_data,
            allow_redirects=True
        )

        if 'Dashboard' not in login_response.text:
            raise Exception("Login failed - check credentials")

        print("✅ Login successful")

    def add_firewall_rule(self, ip_to_block, interface='wan'):
        # Step 1: Go to firewall rules page
        rules_page = self.session.get(f'{self.base_url}/firewall_rules.php')
        soup = BeautifulSoup(rules_page.text, 'html.parser')

        csrf_input = soup.find('input', {'name': '__csrf_magic'})
        if not csrf_input:
            raise Exception("Could not find CSRF token on firewall rules page")
        csrf_token = csrf_input['value']

        # Step 2: Open "add rule" form
        edit_url = f'{self.base_url}/firewall_rules_edit.php?if={interface}&after=-1'
        edit_page = self.session.get(edit_url)
        soup = BeautifulSoup(edit_page.text, 'html.parser')

        csrf_input = soup.find('input', {'name': '__csrf_magic'})
        if not csrf_input:
            raise Exception("Could not find CSRF token on rule edit page")
        edit_csrf_token = csrf_input['value']

        # Step 3: Submit new rule
        rule_data = {
            '__csrf_magic': edit_csrf_token,
            'type': 'block',
            'interface': interface,
            'ipprotocol': 'inet',
            'proto': 'any',
            'icmptype[]': 'any',
            'srctype': 'single',
            'src': ip_to_block,
            'dsttype': 'any',
            'descr': f'Blocking IP {ip_to_block}',
            'dscp': '',
            'tag': '',
            'tagged': '',
            'max': '',
            'max-src-nodes': '',
            'max-src-conn': '',
            'max-src-states': '',
            'max-src-conn-rate': '',
            'max-src-conn-rates': '',
            'statetimeout': '',
            'statetype': 'keep state',
            'vlanprio': '',
            'vlanprioset': '',
            'sched': '',
            'gateway': '',
            'dnpipe': '',
            'pdnpipe': '',
            'ackqueue': '',
            'defaultqueue': '',
            'after': '-1',
            'ruleid': '',
            'save': 'Save'
        }

        rule_response = self.session.post(edit_url, data=rule_data, allow_redirects=True)
        soup = BeautifulSoup(rule_response.text, 'html.parser')
        csrf_input = soup.find('input', {'name': '__csrf_magic'})
        if not csrf_input:
            raise Exception("Could not find CSRF token after rule submission")
        apply_csrf_token = csrf_input['value']

        # Step 4: Apply changes
        apply_data = {
            '__csrf_magic': apply_csrf_token,
            'apply': 'Apply Changes'
        }

        apply_response = self.session.post(
            f'{self.base_url}/firewall_rules.php?if={interface}',
            data=apply_data,
            allow_redirects=True
        )

        if 'The changes have been applied successfully' in apply_response.text:
            print(f"✅ Successfully blocked IP {ip_to_block} on interface {interface}")
        else:
            raise Exception("❌ Failed to apply firewall rule changes")


# ==== Example usage ====
if __name__ == "__main__":
    pfsense_url = "https://192.168.16.10"  
    username = "admin"
    password = "whatwhat§§§2424"
    ip_to_block = "192.168.10.10"  

    try:
        automator = PfSenseAutomator(pfsense_url, username, password)
        automator.login()
        automator.add_firewall_rule(ip_to_block)
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"❌ Error: {str(e)}")
